name: Tristan Potato
desc: A potato from the Patches, boiled in its skin, split and buttered. Tristan potatoes are the staple of the island and are eaten at almost every meal. Restores 100 HP.

name: Crawfish Tail
desc: The tail of a Tristan rock lobster, which the islanders call crawfish, steamed and served with a little butter. The fishery is the island's main income. Restores 170 HP.

name: Tristan Hat
desc: A thick woollen hat knitted on Tristan from the wool of the island's own sheep. It has seen off gales that would have taken a lighthouse.
msg: {name} was kept snug by the Tristan Hat!
